instruction: Candid wedding photograph, medium shot. Outdoors against a green mountain backdrop, a man in a black leather jacket (R1) on the left holds the raised hand of a smiling woman with long curly hair (R2). The woman, wearing a white leather jacket and lace dress, faces forward as she spins, her long hair swirling in the air. Soft, warm daylight illuminates the couple.
